name: brave-api-search
description: Real-time web search, autosuggest, and AI-powered answers using the official Brave Search API. Use for searching documentation, facts, current events, or any web content. Supports AI grounded answers

en.tagline: Brave web search, autosuggest, spellcheck, cited answers
en.summary: A skill that gives an agent four tools built on the official Brave Search API: web search, query autosuggest, spellcheck, and AI answers with inline citations. It is meant for looking up documentation, facts, current events, and other web content.
problem: Without this skill, a developer has to call the Brave Search API directly for each kind of request. Each call needs the right key, retry handling for rate limits, and parsing of the response.

With this skill, the agent runs one of four commands. Keys are read from a local .env file, rate-limited requests are retried, suggestions are cached for 60 seconds, and answers come back with their sources listed.
fit: Looking up current news, recent releases, or technical documentation
Adding query autocomplete and spelling suggestions to a search interface
Getting an answer that lists its cited sources
unfit: Questions the agent can answer from its context or memory
Tasks that need no outside information
steps: Reads `BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY` and `BRAVE_ANSWERS_API_KEY` from a local `.env` file, with optional keys for autosuggest and spellcheck.
Runs one of four tools from the command line: `brave_search`, `brave_suggest`, `brave_spellcheck`, or `brave_answers`.
Sends each request to the official Brave endpoints under `https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1`.
Retries requests that return 429 or 5xx errors, using backoff and the `Retry-After` header when it is present.
For `brave_answers`, streams the answer as it arrives, then prints the sources and the token usage and cost.
Entity extraction and research mode require streaming, which is on by default.

zh.tagline: Brave网页搜索、自动补全、拼写检查与带引用回答
zh.summary: 这是一个为智能体提供四个工具的技能，工具基于 Brave 官方搜索 API，分别用于网页搜索、查询自动补全、拼写检查，以及带行内引用的 AI 回答。适合查文档、核实事实、了解时事和检索其他网页内容。
problem: 如果不用这个技能，开发者需要自己为每类请求直接调用 Brave 搜索 API。每次调用都要使用正确的密钥，处理限流后的重试，并解析返回结果。
使用这个技能后，智能体只需运行四个命令之一。密钥从本地 .env 文件读取，被限流的请求会自动重试，补全建议缓存 60 秒，回答会附带列出的来源。
fit: 查询最新新闻、近期发布版本或技术文档
在搜索界面中加入查询补全和拼写建议
需要获得附带引用来源的回答
unfit: 智能体可以凭上下文或已有知识回答的问题
不需要外部信息的任务
steps: 从本地 `.env` 文件读取 `BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY` 和 `BRAVE_ANSWERS_API_KEY`，补全和拼写检查的密钥可选。
从命令行运行四个工具之一：`brave_search`、`brave_suggest`、`brave_spellcheck` 或 `brave_answers`。
将每个请求发送到 Brave 官方端点 `https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1`。
遇到 429 或 5xx 错误时自动重试，采用退避策略，若返回中有 `Retry-After` 头则按其等待。
使用 `brave_answers` 时，回答边生成边输出，结束后打印来源以及 token 用量和费用。
实体提取和研究模式需要流式输出，该选项默认开启。
